subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat support hiding the New messages recovery action, and if so what manual catch-up affordance must remain available when automatic scrolling is disabled?
rationale: The indicator is both notification UI and the recovery control for persisted auto-scroll Off mode, so implementation cannot safely choose hide, dismiss, or redesign semantics without product intent.

options.title: Add Local Visibility Setting
options.body: Add a browser-local persisted visible/hidden preference while retaining a compact manual scroll-to-latest control whenever auto-scroll is Off.

options.title: Redesign Without A Toggle
options.body: Keep the recovery action universally available but make it smaller, dismissible, or less obstructive instead of allowing full removal.

options.title: Keep Current Behavior
options.body: Retain the current indicator as the required manual catch-up affordance and close the feature request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Add Local Visibility Setting
recommendation.body: Add a browser-local persisted visible/hidden preference while retaining a compact manual scroll-to-latest control whenever auto-scroll is Off.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest product decision owner and has prior review and current-history involvement in this WebChat surface.
